# TinyXML2 11.0.0

Vendored unchanged from the [11.0.0 release](https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2/releases/tag/11.0.0).
`tinyxml2.cpp` and `tinyxml2.h` are compiled into all three photo encoder builds.
The zlib license is reproduced in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
